title: Let subscribers override the half-year new year date in SetHalfYearConventionMethod
summary: The OnBeforeSetHalfYearConventionMethod event now allows subscribers to override the accounting period start date used for half-year depreciation calculations by adding a trailing var parameter that subscribers can populate.
key_points: Event now includes a trailing var NewYearDateOverride parameter that subscribers can set
When a subscriber sets the override, the base code uses that date instead of the accounting period start
Maintains backward compatibility by keeping the existing event signature unchanged
Applied consistently across all localization layers (W1, FR, GB, IT, RU)
Fixes issue where subscribers could set NewYearDate but it was always overwritten
quote: a trailing var NewYearDateOverride parameter is appended, and existing subscribers that omit it continue to compile
